results.title: Bahay-bahayan
results.overview: An OFW mom comes home to start anew with her cold and distant daughter. But to fix the present, they must face their old wounds together.

results.title: Aimée & Samir
results.overview: Aimée de Jongh, a renowned comic-book illustrator, travels to Lesbos to conduct research for her new book about Samir, a fictional Syrian boy.

results.title: Beyond Mamushi
results.overview: When Kate Andrews moved into her dream home with perfect partner Chris Sherbourne, she could never have imagined that her life would be turned on it's head. Chris, now craving power, inflicts bouts of sadistic psychological violence causing Kate to experience violent sporadic hallucinations.  Kate realises that her once dream home has far more going on, with the possibility of an impending personal antithesis that could open an unimaginable hell.

results.title: Cold Shower
results.overview: Anya is a 43-year-old single mother living in Moscow. By day, she scans barcodes at the warehouse of an online retailer to make a living, and the rest of her time is devoted to her two young sons. Every summer, the city shuts off hot water for several days to test the pipes and prepare for the harsh winter ahead. During one of these periods, love and the warmth of a long-forgotten youth suddenly return to Anya’s life like an unexpected rush of hot water after a long wait. However, this awakening soon gives way to a new coldness and bitterness.

results.title: Lily of the Valley
results.overview: In an isolated all-female cult, two sisters are tasked with capturing a man for a sacred sacrifice, but when one begins questioning the faith they were raised to worship, the ritual spirals into a nightmare.

results.title: Scenes From Suffolk
results.overview: Three stories of failure over the course of a single night.

results.title: Nocaretown
results.overview: In the surreal town of Nocaretown, a group of bizarre characters become entangled in a dangerous, absurd quest centered on a mysterious wooden box.

results.title: The Male Gaze: Naughty Boys
results.overview: Bad behavior travels from the bedroom to the classroom to the beach in these six short films from Spain, France, Germany, Australia and Afghanistan that follow wayward boys and men for whom mischief and sexuality go hand in hand.

results.title: In The Eyes
results.overview: Amanita goes to see her friend, Dr. Frankenstein, to solve a problem that is taking up too much space in her life. Because of her very large breasts, men never look her in the eyes!

results.title: Spying Stars
results.overview: Scientist Anandi visits Hanuman Island to perform the last rites ritual for her father. She is immediately placed in quarantine in a remote hotel due to a pandemic caused by a machine-dominant world. When a mysterious star starts following her, she escapes and seeks refuge with a mother and her transgender daughter.

results.title: RZR Cyber Protocol
results.overview: A science fiction thriller immersed in a dystopian world of neural implants, artificial intelligence, cryptocurrency, and black-market crime.

results.title: GLADIO: Monster Battles in the Alternate Dimension
results.original_title: GLADIO: Monster Battles in the Alternate Dimension
results.overview: After a sudden accident during a date, a young man awakens in a desolate alternative dimension alongside his childhood sweetheart. Forced into a brutal monster battle against the terrifying Kaiju Gladio, they must uncover the mystery of their arrival and fight for their survival to return to the real world.

results.title: The Girl
results.overview: Haunted by her recent past, a police lieutenant investigates a mysterious case known as 'The Sugar Girl': the appearance of a young girl in a city hotel. Although the authorities do not take the case seriously, the lieutenant suspects there is something deeper hidden, unaware that a macabre truth lies beneath.

results.title: Mantra Muugdha
results.overview: A magical, musical, maddening ride where the music will unleash a thrilling adventure of a lifetime.

results.title: Togel: Diantara PHK dan Hutang
results.overview: After losing his job, Agus pretends to leave for work every morning to spare his pregnant wife the truth. Instead, he roams the streets looking for work and borrowing money just to survive. When Rijal, an old friend with a gambling habit and a talent for bad decisions, reappears, Agus tries his luck with a lottery "magic book" that promises winning numbers. Instead of getting rich, he is chased by debt collectors and forced to hide from his wife's family. Things get stranger when he meets Om Jhon, a quirky ghost who claims to know the secret to lucky numbers. Desperate for one number to change his life, Agus is pulled into a chaotic, darkly funny adventure.

results.title: Life Within
results.overview: How to carry life inside you while surrounded by the threats of death? In blockaded Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabakh), a pregnant mother carries both hope and fear, as war, hunger, and deprivation threaten the fragile life within her.

results.title: Heggana Muddu
results.overview: Ajitha and Prerana's union quickly unravels when mysteries and misunderstandings take over. Humor meets tension as they confront shocking revelations about love, loyalty, and the strangers hiding behind familiar faces.

results.title: Left Behind, Still Standing
results.overview: When the steel factory she’s working to dismantle comes back to life one night, immigrant Morana must face the fragility of her own existence - and how much she truly has in common with the laid-off workers.

results.title: Mira
results.overview: Mira dreams of becoming a truck driver. As adolescence transforms her body, the way others look at her begins to change. Her dream is suddenly in jeopardy, but Mira isn't ready to give up on it.

results.title: Drax
results.overview: Drax, a centuries-old vampire hiding in plain sight, spends his nights painting and resisting the urge to feed. But when he meets Marcus, a magnetic young skater, the lines between hunger, desire, and connection begin to blur.
